findings.fix: Remove the @media (orientation: portrait) rule that hides content, or ensure content remains visible and usable in both portrait and landscape orientations.
findings.violation: The @media rule hides #main-content when the device orientation is portrait, locking the page to landscape and preventing users from viewing content when their device is rotated.

findings.fix: Remove the outline:none style and provide a visible focus indicator via CSS (e.g., outline, box-shadow, or background-color change) that meets the 3:1 contrast minimum against adjacent colors.
findings.violation: This link has style="outline:none" which removes the focus outline with no visible replacement focus indicator, making it impossible for keyboard users to see which element has keyboard focus.

findings.evidence: <div class="icon-delete" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Delete item" id="s3-customcontrol" style="width:16px;height:16px">
findings.fix: Increase the element's width and height to at least 24px (or 24 CSS pixels), or surround it with additional clickable space to achieve the 24x24px minimum.
findings.location: #s3-customcontrol, <div> custom button control with aria-label 'Delete item', line 45
findings.violation: This button has width:16px;height:16px, which is below the 24x24px minimum target size required for pointer activation.

findings.evidence: Your changes are saved.
findings.fix: Add role="status" and aria-live="polite" to the #s3-statuscard element, or wrap the status text in an element with these attributes.
findings.location: #s3-statuscard, <div> element with text 'Your changes are saved.', line 41
findings.violation: This status message is not wrapped in a status region (role="status") or an element with aria-live="polite", so users of assistive technology may not be notified when the status changes.
